2459-5006-6495-8170.easyPrerequisites:
You can pay for Rograkh's commander tax if applicable.
You haven't cast a spell using Lurrus this turn if Rograkh is starting in your graveyard.
2459-5006-6495-8170.description:
Cast Rograkh by paying {0}.
Flickering Hound triggers, blinking Lurrus.
Resolve the Rograkh spell. Then, activate Evereth by sacrificing Rograkh, putting a +1/+1 counter on Evereth
Repeat.
2459-5006-6495-8170.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1251-4770-6006-6090.description:
Cast Whitemane Lion by paying its mana cost.
When Whitemane Lion enters, it and Arahbo trigger.
Resolve the Arahbo trigger, creating a 1/1 Cat creature token.
Holding priority, activate Whitemane Lion and the Cat token by tapping them, adding {1}{W}.
Resolve the Whitemane Lion ability, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Repeat.

728-2366-5929-6879.easyPrerequisites:
You are able to play a land this turn.
"[Type]" chosen with Leyline of Transformation.
728-2366-5929-6879.description:
Play Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Activate Dryad Arbor by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Grimgrin by sacrificing Dryad Arbor.
When Dryad Abor dies, Haru triggers, returning Dryad Arbor from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Dryad Arbor enters as an Ally due to Leyline of Transformation, Haru triggers, earthbending Dryad Arbor.
Resolve the Grimgrin ability.
Repeat from step 3.

1981-2415-6495-6752.easyPrerequisites:
You control another creature.
You have 2 or more life.
1981-2415-6495-6752.description:
Activate Evereth by sacrificing a creature.
When the creature dies, Havoc Jester triggers, dealing 1 damage to you.
Darien triggers, creating a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
When the Soldier enters, Haliya triggers, causing you to gain life
Resolve the Evereth ability.
Repeat.
1981-2415-6495-6752.notes: If you have a way to kill Evereth and {1}{B/R} available, you can do so after putting a significant amount of +1/+1 counters on it to deal damage to each opponent using its second ability.

1170-7499-7875.easyPrerequisites: Pest Friend must have valid targets.
1170-7499-7875.description:
Cast Pest Friend using the convoke ability from Party Thrasher by tapping Lluwen, Exchange Student.
Displacer Kitten triggers, blinking Lluwen, Exchange Student, which enters prepared.
Resolve Pest Friend.
Repeat.
1170-7499-7875.notes: If you have a way to cause the infinite Pest tokens to die, this combo also produces infinite lifegain and infinite lifegain triggers.

uses.battlefieldCardState: without summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent

568-1267-7669.description:
Deal combat damage using Medomai, triggering its ability, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Cast Eaten by Piranhas by paying its mana cost, attaching it to Medomai and causing it to lose its abilities.
Declare Medomai as an attacker.
Holding priority, cast Capsize with buyback by paying {4}{U}{U}, returning Eaten by Piranhas and Capsize to your hand.
Repeat from step 1.

5315-6871-6879-7298.description:
Cast Firdoch Core by paying {3}.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Activate Ravenous Intruder by sacrificing Firdoch Core.
When Firdoch Core dies, Haru triggers, returning Firdoch Core from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Firdoch Core enters, Haru triggers, earthbending Firdoch Core, as it's a land due to Toph.
Resolve the Ravenous Intruder ability.
Repeat from step 3.

328-2921-5220-6900.easyPrerequisites: Your life total is at least 6 if Gray Merchant is on the top of your library, or you have {3}{B}{B} available otherwise.
328-2921-5220-6900.description:
Cast Gray Merchant either from your hand by paying {3}{B}{B} or from the top of your library by paying 5 life.
When Gray Merchant enters, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose life equal to your devotion to black and causing you to gain life equal to the life lost this way.
Activate Bartolomé del Presidio by sacrificing Gray Merchant.
When Gray Merchant dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Gray Merchant from your graveyard onto the top of your library.
Resolve the Bartolomé del Presidio ability.
Repeat.

339-677-997-1879.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

659-4381-4613-4927.notablePrerequisites: You control a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it.
659-4381-4613-4927.description:
Activate a creature with a +1/+1 counter on it, creating a 1/1 red Goblin creature token.
The 1/1 Goblin token enters with a +1/+1 counter on it due to Grumgully's ability.
Repeat.

880-2653-6662.description:
Activate Perilous Forays by paying {1} and sacrificing a creature, causing you to search your library for a land card with a basic land type and put it onto the battlefield tapped.
When the land enters the battlefield Nissa and Chocobo Racetrack trigger.
Resolve the Nissa trigger, adding {1}.
Resolve the Chocobo Racetrack trigger, creating a creature token.
Repeat.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to any other creature you control

3259-4885-6642.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
3259-4885-6642.description:
At the beginning of your combat phase, SOLDIER Military Program triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one. 
Repeat each combat phase.
3259-4885-6642.notes: If you control a commander, you can choose both of SOLDIER Military Program's modes.

3129-4508-4875-5880.description:
Activate Magmaw by paying {1} and sacrificing another nonland permanent, dealing 1 damage to an opponent.
Malcolm triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate a Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {1}.
Repeat.

280-774-3470.description:
Activate Patron of the Moon by paying {1}, putting Golgari Rot Farm from your hand onto the battlefield tapped.
When Golgari Rot Farm enters the battlefield, it and Lotus Cobra trigger.
Resolve the Golgari Rot Farm trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Lotus Cobra trigger, adding {1}.
Repeat.

2034-4871-6116.description:
Activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing Haunt of the Dead Marshes, adding {C}{C}.
When Haunt of the Dead Marshes dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Activate the Treasure by tapping and sacrificing it, adding {B}.
Activate Haunt of the Dead Marshes by paying {2}{B}, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat.

654-4094-5702-5954.easyPrerequisites: Springheart Nantuko attached to Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
654-4094-5702-5954.notablePrerequisites:
Kaya has at least two loyalty counters on it.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods does not have summoning sickness.
654-4094-5702-5954.description:
Activate Kaya's second loyalty ability by removing two loyalty counters from it, causing you to double any tokens you create this turn.
Declare Overlord of the Hauntwoods as an attacker.
Overlord of the Hauntwoods triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
When the Everywhere tokens enter the battlefield, Amulet of Vigor and Springheart Nantuko trigger twice.
Resolve both Amulet of Vigor triggers, untapping both Everywhere tokens.
Holding priority, activate the Everywhere tokens by tapping them, adding {1}{G}.
Resolve the first Springheart Nantuko trigger, choosing not to pay and create a 1/1 Insect creature token.
Resolve the second Springheart Nantuko trigger, causing you to pay {1}{G} to create a token copy of Overlord of the Hauntwoods.
When the Overlord of the Hauntwoods token enters the battlefield, it triggers, creating two tapped Everywhere land tokens.
Repeat from step 4.

1987-3821-4863.notablePrerequisites: You control up to five lands that can tap to produce at least {2}{U}.
1987-3821-4863.description:
Activate up to five lands by tapping them, adding at least {2}{U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {2}{U}, blinking Revolutionist and Peregrine Drake.
When Revolutionist and Peregrine Drake enter the battlefield, their abilities trigger.
Resolve the Revolutionist trigger, returning Ghostly Flicker to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the Peregrine Drake trigger, untapping up to five lands.
Repeat.
1987-3821-4863.notes: If you control five lands that can tap to produce at least {3}{U}, this combo nets infinite mana, and you may blink any other permanent besides Peregrine Drake.

1799-2579-2701-3277-4050.description:
Cast Dark Ritual by paying {B}, adding {B}{B}{B}.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Izzet Chronarch, adding one mana of any color.
When Izzet Chronarch dies, The Cauldron of Eternity triggers, putting Izzet Chronarch from your graveyard onto the bottom of your library.
Activate Grenzo by paying {2}, putting Izzet Chronarch from the bottom of your library into your graveyard, and then putting it onto the battlefield.
When Izzet Chronarch enters the battlefield, it triggers, returning Dark Ritual from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite mana, you may activate Grenzo's ability any number of times.

1267-5408-5459.notablePrerequisites:
Auriok Windwalker does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least two additional creatures, one of which does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
1267-5408-5459.description:
Declare a creature you control that cannot be blocked by an opponent as an attacker.
Holding priority, activate Auriok Windwalker by tapping it, attaching Assimilation Aegis to the attacking creature.
Assimilation Aegis' second ability triggers, causing the creature to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Deal combat damage with the creature.
The creature triggers, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Move to your next turn.
Activate Assimilation Aegis' equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to any other creature you control except Auriok Windwalker.
Assimilation Aegis' second ability triggers, causing the creature to become a copy of Medomai the Ageless.
Repeat.

293-1930-2440-5220.description:
Activate Undercity Informer by paying {1} and sacrificing Narcomoeba.
When Narcomoeba dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Narcomoeba on top of your library from your graveyard.
Resolve the Undercity Informer ability, causing you to put Narcomoeba into your graveyard from the top of your library.
Narcomoeba triggers, returning itself to the battlefield from your graveyard.
When Narcomoeba enters the battlefield, Mana Echoes triggers, adding at least {C}.
Repeat.
If you control at least one other Illusion, this combo will net infinite colorless mana.

723-1209-4067.description:
Activate Captain Sisay by tapping it, searching your library for Kozilek and putting it into your hand.
Activate Mind Over Matter by discarding Kozilek.
Kozilek triggers, shuffling your graveyard into your library.
Resolve the Mind Over Matter ability, untapping Captain Sisay.
Repeat.

1923-4050-4365.description:
Cast Summon the School by paying {3}{W}, creating four 1/1 Merfolk Wizard creature tokens.
Activate Summon the School by tapping four Merfolk you control, returning it from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Phyrexian Altar four times by sacrificing the Merfolk Wizards, adding {3}{W}.
Repeat.

210-220-5184-5195.description:
Cast Chain Lightning by paying {R}, targeting Brash Taunter.
Storm-Kiln Artist triggers, creating two Treasure tokens.
Activate both Treasure tokens by tapping and sacrificing them, adding {R}{R}.
Resolve Chain Lightning, dealing 3 damage to Brash Taunter, and causing you to pay {R}{R} to copy Chain Lightning, targeting Brash Taunter.
Brash Taunter and Storm-Kiln Artist each trigger.
Resolve the Brash Taunter trigger, dealing 3 damage to an opponent.
Resolve the Storm-Kiln Artist trigger, creating two Treasure tokens.
Repeat from step 3.
